nom: Avène Mineral Sunscreen Multi-Defense Fluid SPF 50+

segments.sensitive: Reviewers with sensitive skin, including a parent applying it to a hypersensitive child, broadly report no irritation, stinging or allergic reaction.
segments.dry: One long-time user describes her skin as very dry and sensitive and says a recent reformulation is less hydrating than before; another reviewer noticed her skin felt drier than usual after removing the sunscreen at the end of the day.
segments.oily: Reviewers with oily or acne-prone skin, including a teenager, report the formula feels lightweight rather than greasy and does not cause breakouts.
segments.combination: One reviewer with combination skin reports the sunscreen controls oil and shine in her T-zone throughout the day.

concerns.dehydration: A couple of reviewers note the sunscreen can leave skin feeling drier than usual once removed, and one says it may lack hydration for dry skin without a moisturizer underneath; others describe it as hydrating or melting into the skin without a dry after-feel.
concerns.redness: A reviewer applying it to a hypersensitive child and another describing her own skin as sensitive report no irritation, redness or breakouts from daily use.
concerns.oiliness: Reviewers with oily, combination or acne-prone skin generally report good oil control and a natural, non-greasy finish; one reviewer cautions that oilier skin tones may see more shine or cast and suggests setting with powder.
concerns.blemishes: Multiple reviewers, including ones with oily, acne-prone or hypersensitive skin, report no breakouts from regular use.

aspects.libelle: Runny, watery texture requiring vigorous shaking
Minimal white cast for most skin tones
Recent reformulation is thinner, smaller bottle
Layers well under makeup without pilling
Compact size convenient for travel and reapplication
Pricey for the amount of product

extraits.titre: Just stopped using after years of only this
extraits.texte: I'm a long-time Avène lover, but recently in preparation for potential import tariffs in the U.S., I've been trying to find U.S. brands that are good for sensitive skin. However, this sunscreen (and the one-of-a-kind Avène Cicalfate+) was going to be the one thing I continued using, regardless. Then, they changed the formula slightly and reduced the fluid ounces offered from 1.7 to 1.3, which means I now need to buy two bottles every month to cover my face, back of the neck, throat, chest, and backs of the hands/my forearms if they're going to be uncovered—just once daily. That was upsetting enough. This new formulation also isn't as gentle nor as hydrating as the previous (although just as runny, which I never really cared about), and as someone with Sahara-dry skin that's also hyper sensitive, this no longer is my top choice. I have three bottles left and I intend to finish them, but I won't be repurchasing in the future. Still, due to chronic illness and other skin issues, I don't spend a lot of time out in the sun. For the past (I believe) 9-11 years, this has prevented sunburn. I'm a former Floridian, born and raised, and have lived in Seattle for almost 8 years. (Contrary to what people think, Seattle often feels brighter than the Tampa Bay are of Florida did.) And even with genetics not being on the winning side, I my skin looks younger than most of my peers—even younger women—without surgical, dermatological/laser, or injectable intervention. extraits.titre: Great Quality but White Cast Shows Up on Skin
extraits.texte: I've been using the Avene Mineral Sunscreen Multi-Defense Fluid SPF 50+ for a while now, and it has some standout qualities along with a few drawbacks. Pros: ✅ Gentle on Sensitive Skin: This sunscreen is fragrance-free and formulated for sensitive skin, which is a huge plus. I've experienced no irritation, redness, or breakouts, even with regular use. ✅ Lightweight Texture: The fluid consistency makes it easy to spread and blend into the skin without feeling greasy or heavy. ✅ Great for Daily Use: It layers well under makeup and doesn't pill, which makes it a solid choice for everyday wear. ✅ Effective Protection: With SPF 50+, it provides strong protection against UVA/UVB rays and environmental aggressors. Cons: ❗ White Cast: Since it's a mineral sunscreen, there's a noticeable white cast, especially on medium to deeper skin tones. With extra blending, it fades somewhat, but it may still be visible. ❗ Drying on Some Skin Types: While the formula isn't overly mattifying, those with dry skin may find it a bit lacking in hydration. Pairing it with a moisturizer helps. ❗ Price Point: It's on the pricier side compared to some other mineral sunscreens, though the quality and gentle formula may justify the cost for those with sensitive skin.

This sunscreen was easy to apply and lives up to its lightweight name. It rubs in well with minimal white cast. Hard to tell cause I'm kinda pale. It's not heavy or sticky, which is great. I took off a star cause it doesn't feel very moisturizing. In fact, after proper removal(oil cleanse then face wash), my skin felt dry when it normally doesn't. I'm shelving this until it's a little more humid out.

extraits.titre: Mineral Sunscreen SPF 50+ for sensitive Face Skin
extraits.texte: I have been using the Avène Mineral Sunscreen Multi-Defense Fluid SPF 50+ for over a month now. First: I like how invisible this sunscreen is! There is no grayish, bluish or white cast after applying! I added pictures of my and my son skin, my skin is fair and his is tan (makeup tones). Second: There is no typical sunscreen scent, it has a scent but more like a thick cream smells. Third: The Ingredients! There is Niacinamide for even skin, Bisabolol & Allontoin to soothe & calm skin, and also Pro-Vitamin E to protect against environmental oxidative stress. Oxidative Stress in Skin plays a significant role in skin aging and disease, leading to visible signs like wrinkles, fine lines, and pigmentation! Overall the Avène Multi-Defense Fluid SPF 50+ for sensitive face skin, is a sunscreen that I would definitely get again and also let my son use it! My son's skin is hypersensitive and he gets allergic reactions to a lot of different products, he didn't got a skin reaction with this fluid.

This sunscreen has a pleasantly liquid texture that allows for effortless application, ensuring an even spread across the skin without any heavy or greasy sensation. It absorbs quickly, leaving no overpowering scent or unsightly white cast behind. As someone with combination skin, I apply this sunscreen every morning before my makeup, and I've noticed it provides excellent oil control in my T-zone, minimizing shine throughout the day. I particularly appreciate that it boasts SPF 50, offering robust protection against UVA I, UVA II, UVB rays, and even visible blue light. This sunscreen has definitely earned its place in my daily skincare routine!

extraits.titre: No crazy white residue on your face!
extraits.texte: Could it be? A mineral sunscreen that doesn't leave being the white cast? It is actually lightweight and sheer! It works and won't make you look like you have white Halloween makeup on! It even works for teens with oily acne prone skin because it isn't crazy thick or make the face feel greasy.
